estimate.factory_basis: Calculated shared-facility factory-gate scenario: machine-use allocation and one campaign tooling allocation. Capacity, routes and supplier availability are unverified. A new specialist factory is outside this station-module budget.
limitations: Every monetary rate and process duration here is a provisional engineering hypothesis, editable and source-bound.
China benchmark is context only: rebar is not qualified spring wire, a pressure vessel, a flywheel or a composite laminate.
No additional bulk percentage discount is applied; repeated tooling is charged once per declared production batch.
No captured-energy benefit is credited from initial storage. Required power never becomes available capacity.
Station module prices exclude the unchanged railway, rolling stock fleet, stations and route civil works. Per-train interface allowances remain separate until a candidate-specific fleet exists.
Fatigue cycle lives and maintenance renewals are cost sensitivities, not demonstrated service lives.
Foundations, containment and protection allowances are calculated planning reserves, not approved designs.

Rear/front/distributed launch costs count each positive force point, its rope/drum/clutch and fixed/load-dependent frame reserve. The 160 t equal-mass scenario includes a common unresolved vehicle-interface allowance; it is not a completed per-arrangement vehicle mass model.
Factory process rates assume shared facilities. A greenfield specialist factory and procurement lead times require a separate make/buy/capacity scenario.

Maintenance free-space uses a cubic-store proxy with a declared clearance in a host-station site; site acquisition/building and viaduct redesign remain outside this module. Bolts and wiring are planning reserves, not verified joints or electrical ratings.
